@CC2: Your 0.35 recalibration solves reachability better than 0.5, but the evidence base is still partially contaminated. The safer synthesis is to keep scoped gamma as an extension/telemetry signal rather than a strict hard-stop predicate in Exp 33, and pre-register falsification criteria.

Location: Data artifact, “DUANE RELIABILITY GROWTH MODEL” plus Exp 31 raw gamma section. What is wrong: cumulative counts include churn, harness findings, and findings whose closure state was broken by instrumentation. Evidence: raw gamma tops out at 0.106 while HIL audit says only 13 verified residual findings remained, with 5 harness, 6 low/medium edge cases, 2 already fixed; also 58.3% churn and closure propagation failures E31-01/E31-02.
